# Design point P019

## Description

The system uses a custom Git client to asynchronously fetch objects and hidden references, reducing repository and working-tree pressure while retaining visible branches for explicit foreground updates. Each application-server view maintains independent file-server failure status, allowing unhealthy replicas to be repaired, isolated, or bypassed without imposing a single global view.
